task.description: Rework pass on scripts/test_parallel.sh's aggregation (design section 4.5) and exit-code (section 4.6) logic, driven by CODE-DESIGNER's REWORK-ITERATION-1 correction (commit 376bb81, re-gated PASS by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR at df5b2a9). Original implementation (commit fa143b7) parsed a 'N tests, M failures' summary shape this toolchain's real cli_formatter.ex never produces; RELEASE-VALIDATOR's real mix test run showed the actual shape is a 'Result: <passed>[/<total>] passed [(<type breakdown>)]' line plus an optional separate 'Failed: <n> <type>[, ...]' line, and that on this toolchain exit 2 (not 1) is the normal ExUnit-failure exit code.
acceptance_criteria: Parsing matches design section 4.5's grammar exactly, including the no-parenthetical single-type case and the 0/1/2-exit-code semantics from section 2.2
Parsed failure count (failures_i), not raw exit_i, is the authoritative success signal for the script's own exit code (section 4.6)
No hardcoded partition count; pre-compile still happens exactly once before any partition launch; no DB-destructive operations

result.summary: Rewrote scripts/test_parallel.sh's Step 4 (aggregate) and Step 5 (exit-code) sections to match the reworked design exactly. Parsing now locates the last '^Result: ' line and, separately, the last '^Failed: ' line per partition: handles 'Result: N/M passed', 'Result: N passed' (no slash), and the degenerate 'Result: 0 tests' case; extracts the parenthesized per-type breakdown when present ('(K properties, N tests)' or '(a/b properties, c/d tests)', using each entry's total -- the number after '/' if present, else the bare count); when no parenthetical is present, attributes the full total to tests_i (properties_i=0) per the design's documented single-type assumption. Failed line, when present, sums every count immediately preceding a propert(y|ies)|tests? token. Implemented the section-4.5 cross-check exactly as specified (four cases: no Result line -> failed unconditionally with WARNING; exit 0/failures 0 -> consistent, silent; exit 2/failures>0 -> consistent, silent; exit 2/failures 0 -> WARNING only, not failed; anything else -> WARNING and failed). Step 5's exit code is now purely a function of the parsed failures_i/has-Result-line signal (any_failed), not raw exits[] values, per section 4.6's corrected contract. bash -n scripts/test_parallel.sh passed. Sanity-checked the new parsing logic in isolation (not via the real script or mix test) against the three example log-line shapes from RELEASE-VALIDATOR's real run quoted in step-05's handoff -- 'Result: 207 passed (2 properties, 205 tests)' -> properties=2 tests=205 failures=0; 'Result: 115 passed' (no parenthetical) -> properties=0 tests=115 failures=0; 'Result: 163/171 passed (1/2 properties, 162/169 tests)' + 'Failed: 1 property, 7 tests' -> properties=2 tests=169 failures=8 (matches the design's '8 tests failed' example arithmetic). Did not run mix test or launch the real script end-to-end per instruction -- RELEASE-VALIDATOR re-executes next. Self-review: N-derivation (TEST_PARALLEL_N/nproc/getconf, no hardcoded fallback) and the single pre-compile-before-launch ordering are both unchanged from the prior PASS pass; grepped the diff for dropdb/ecto.drop/TRUNCATE/DROP -- none present.
